newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse consolidates upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse consolidates upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed its two-hour trading on Tuesday 0.64 percent higher on the strength of expected positive 1996 results from main shares, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 471.18 points, up from 468.20 on Monday.
"The market is consolidating its upward trend due to the expected 1996 positive results of main listed companies," a Casablanca-based market analyst said.
Investors predict that stocks will show better results than expected, he said.
ONA group, the country's largest conglomerate, was traded at 582 dirhams, up 12 dirhams on the previous session.
The group, which has diversified stakes in more than 100 firms, expects more than 720 million dirhams net profits for 1996, a broker said.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market's largest stock, rose one dirham to close at 711 dirhams.
Samir firm, Morocco's main oil refinery, and Societe Nationale d'Investissement conglomerate remained stable at 235 dirhams and 565 dirhams respectively.
Traded volume on the official market was 37.6 million dirhams, up from 25.5 million on Monday.
